```{r}

head(nfl_cleaned)
```

```{r}
off_vars <- nfl_cleaned %>%
  select(Points_Scored, Off_First_Downs, Off_Total_Yards, Off_Passing_Yards, Off_Rushing_Yards, Turnovers_Lost)
head(off_vars)

  select(Points_Allowed, Def_First_Downs, Def_Total_Yards, Def_Passing_Yards, Def_Rushing_Yards, Turnovers_Gained)
head(def_vars)
```
